desc: Derive the exact cost model for converting original letter frequencies into a target equal frequency using deletion, insertion, and forward-only character changes.
Design a two-state DP over consecutive alphabet letters for each fixed target frequency, with correct adjacent conversion savings.
Validate the DP on provided examples, targeted edge cases, and brute-force small instances.
Prove the target-frequency enumeration range and analyze time complexity.
Finalize the Python implementation in the required starter-code format.
